tours.name: Valley of Flowers Trek
tours.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site in Chamoli — endless alpine meadows filled with hundreds of rare Himalayan flower species at 3,658m.

tours.name: Rishikesh Rafting & Bungee
tours.description: Conquer Grade III & IV white water rapids on the Ganga river and experience India's highest 83m cliff bungee jump in Rishikesh.

tours.name: Chopta Tungnath Trek
tours.description: Trek through lush rhododendron forests to Tungnath — the highest Shiva temple in the world at 3,680m with panoramic summit views.

tours.name: Jim Corbett Safari
tours.description: Embark on an exciting Jeep safari inside India's legendary national park to spot Royal Bengal Tigers, wild Asian elephants, and rare flora.

tours.name: Auli Skiing & Cable Car
tours.description: Experience India's premier skiing destination in winter and ride one of Asia's longest gondola cable cars with views of Nanda Devi.

travelGuide.heading: Discover Uttarakhand with Musafir Trails
paragraphs: Uttarakhand, revered as Devbhoomi (Land of the Gods), offers an unmatched blend of divine spirituality, high-altitude trekking trails, and pristine hill stations. At Musafir Trails, we help thousands of travelers discover the Sacred Himalayas each year with customized itineraries, reliable outstation taxi rentals, and complete tour management.

From the sacred gates of Haridwar and Rishikesh to the snow-covered peaks of Kedarnath, Badrinath, Yamunotri, and Gangotri, our local team in Dehradun ensures your travel experience is safe, comfortable, and memorable. Whether you need an Innova Crysta cab for family travel, a helicopter Yatra ticket, or a guided trek to the Valley of Flowers, Musafir Trails is your trusted companion across Uttarakhand.
